question: Citizens in democracies must be able to freely debate important political topics online. In this context, I call on the Commission to answer the following questions: 1.

Does the DSA, Commission guidance, or any instruments thereunder require platforms to pre-emptively moderate political speech outside of the EU simply because their content may spill over into the EU?

Does the DSA, Commission guidance, or any instruments thereunder require or encourage platforms to remove or moderate political content, such as criticism of government officials or policies, scientific debate, statistical facts, or interviews of public officials or candidates for public office?

Designated very large online platforms state that their respective content moderation policies apply globally. Does the DSA, Commission guidance, or any instruments thereunder require them to substantially modify their content moderation policies? If so, how?
